note: Attacker-controlled TGA bytes are placed into a QBuffer as the input device.
The 18-byte TGA header is parsed: image_type=10 (RLE_RGB), width=1, height=1, pixel_size=16.
Header passes IsSupported: RLE_RGB with colormap_type=0, nonzero dimensions, pixel_size=16.
size = 1*1*2 = 2 bytes of pixel data expected.
2-byte image buffer allocated via malloc; contents are uninitialized.
RLE packet header byte 0x80 is read; count = (0x80 & 0x7f) + 1 = 1.
readRawData(pixel, 2) is called but only 1 byte (0xAA) remains in the stream, so it returns 1 and pixel[1] remains uninitialized.
1 initialized byte (0xAA) and 1 uninitialized byte from pixel are copied into the image buffer, propagating uninitialized data.
Reads 2 bytes as a Color555 struct; the second byte is uninitialized, so the bitfield extraction of c.r, c.g, c.b reads uninitialized memory, triggering MSAN Use-of-uninitialized-value.
